The 'AI STATES' legend in the top-right is the most prominent element due to its high-contrast white text and solid background, drawing the eye away from the simulation. The 'PLAYER INSPECTOR' in the bottom-left is visually heavy and obscures the tactical map, creating a 'dead zone' where pathfinding cannot be observed. The 'MOVE (WASD)' button is a high-contrast distraction that competes with the simulation data.
